Nandini rolls a ball down a slope. The distance travelled is s(t) = 3t² + 4t metres after t seconds.
(i) Find the average velocity between t = 6 s and t = 6.1 s. (ii) Write [s(6 + h) − s(6)]/h in simplest form. (iii) Find the instantaneous velocity at t = 6 s. (iv) Find the velocity at any time t.
items.markingKey: (i) [s(t₂) − s(t₁)]/(t₂ − t₁) (1). (ii) expand and divide by h (1). (iii) let h → 0 (1). (iv) s′(t) from first principles (1).
